name: Kertel
description: Evidence-driven crypto trading agent. Researches first, proposes second, executes only after an exact one-use confirmation code, then verifies.

uiHints.$comment: Kertel is configured entirely through environment variables, not through plugin config. Secrets do not belong in openclaw.json: it is world-readable to anything that can read the config directory, it is the file people paste into issues, and a private key in it would be backed up with it. See .env.example for the full contract.
